intro: Wings Etc is the Midwest wings-and-sports-pub chain (Wings Etc. Grill & Pub) known for its bone-in and boneless wings in a long list of sauces, plus burgers, wraps, big salads and classic bar appetizers, all served in a casual game-day setting. Below is the Wings Etc menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Wings Etc, boneless wings start around $13.19 and bone-in wings around $13.79 (the price rises with the count), the Stand-By Burger is about $16.19, chicken wraps $16.79, and the Big Chicken Salad $17.39. Wings in a wide range of sauces are the signature. Prices shown lean toward delivery level, so in-store runs lower. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Wings Etc value: weekday wing specials (like discounted wing nights) are the best-known deals, and a smaller wing count or a chicken wrap ($16.79) is the cheaper order. In-store prices run lower than the delivery menu, so dine in or order pickup to save. Prices vary by location and wing count.

faqs.q: How much are wings at Wings Etc?
faqs.a: Boneless wings start around $13.19 and bone-in wings around $13.79, with the price rising based on the wing count you order. These lean toward delivery-menu prices, so in-store is often lower. Weekday wing specials are the best value. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Wings Etc known for?
faqs.a: Wings Etc (Wings Etc. Grill & Pub) is a Midwest wings-and-sports-pub chain known for its bone-in and boneless wings in a long list of sauces, plus burgers, wraps and big salads, served in a casual game-day setting with the games on.

faqs.q: Does Wings Etc have food besides wings?
faqs.a: Yes. Beyond wings, Wings Etc serves burgers like the Stand-By Burger ($16.19), chicken wraps ($16.79), big salads ($17.39), and classic pub appetizers and sides. It is a full grill-and-pub menu, not just a wing counter.

Wings Etc publishes nutrition information in its restaurants and online, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. Totals depend on the wing style, the sauce, the count and the sides you add.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Wings Etc?
faqs.a: Favorites include the bone-in wings, the boneless wings, the Stand-By Burger, the buffalo chicken wrap, and the Big Chicken Salad.
